# zeroword_environment_theme (Resource)

Hosted Login theme of one Environment (`PUT /environments/{id}/theme`). The API has no delete, so destroying this resource only removes it from state and leaves the last theme in place. Activating a social connection appends its provider to `methods` when it is missing; list every active provider in `methods` to avoid a diff after that.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zeroword_environment_theme" "staging" {
  environment_id = zeroword_environment.staging.id
  theme = jsonencode({
    appearance = {
      primaryColor    = "#111827"
      backgroundColor = "#ffffff"
      textColor       = "#111827"
      borderRadius    = 12
      fontFamily      = "system"
      density         = "comfortable"
    }
    colorScheme = "system"
    darkAppearance = {
      primaryColor    = "#f9fafb"
      backgroundColor = "#111827"
      textColor       = "#f9fafb"
    }
    methods       = ["passkey", "email_otp"]
    defaultLocale = "ja"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID (`env_...`).
- `theme` (String) Theme document as JSON (use `jsonencode`). It replaces the whole theme; see https://docs.zeroword.smartcrab.ai/hosted-login for the allowed keys.

### Read-Only

- `version` (Number) Theme version, incremented on every save.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the Environment ID.
terraform import zeroword_environment_theme.staging env_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
